subject: Consumption journey map and commit scenarios
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@brightwelllabs.com>, Tom O'Neil <tom.oneil@brightwelllabs.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consumption journey map and commit scenarios

Hi Alyssa / Tom,

Thanks again for the time last week. As we head into Brightwell's renewal window in August, my ask is to run a short consumption health + options review so we can align on a commit that matches your roadmap and avoids any capacity surprises.

Attached: brightwell_q2_usage_dashboard.pdf (Q2 token mix + cadence) and a short ROI snapshot.

Proposed 30-min agenda:
- Current token cadence and peak patterns (CS)
- 2 commit scenarios (12 / 18 months) and unit economics (Sales)
- Ops/SLA implications and dedicated capacity options (CS/Eng)

Can you share the internal forecast (tokens/month) you expect over the next 6 months, and whether there are any planned feature launches that will change the mix (e.g., more embeddings vs. chat gen)? I can put together 3 scenarios for our meeting.

Availability: Thu 5/13 between 10–12 PT or Fri 5/14 afternoon PT — what works for you?

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

(attachment: brightwell_q2_usage_dashboard.pdf - PDF)
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@brightwelllabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Tom O'Neil <tom.oneil@brightwelllabs.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consumption journey map and commit scenarios

Ben — thanks, this looks useful. Quick context from our side:
- Current average tokens/day: ~1.1M, with embeddings (~60%) for vector search and chat generation (~30%).
- Peak daily jobs (batch embed pipelines) occur nightly 02:00–04:00 PT and account for ~35% of weekly tokens.
- Planned launch: Tweaked recommendations engine in July that could add ~20–30% uplift in embeddings.

We'd like to see both 12- and 18-month pricing (and ideally a growth scenario that factors in the July launch). Please include CS in any ops discussion — p99 latency spikes during high batch runs have been a concern.

Thu 5/13 10:30 PT works for us.

—Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Head of Data Platform | Brightwell Labs
alyssa@brightwelllabs.com
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@brightwelllabs.com>, Tom O'Neil <tom.oneil@brightwelllabs.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consumption journey map and commit scenarios

Thanks for the details, Alyssa — helpful. A few operational notes from our end before the call:

- Token mix: the attachment (roi_snapshot_v2.xlsx) shows that your embeddings-heavy mix lowers per-token cost sensitivity but increases KV cache pressure during nightly jobs.
- Latency: we've observed p99 spikes that correlate with concurrent batch window overlaps; recommendation is either (a) stagger batch windows by 30–60 minutes or (b) reserve a modest dedicated pool for nightly embed jobs to keep p99 stable for the online chat tier.
- Caching opportunity: enabling prefix caching for the recommendation inference path could cut token processing by ~12% (we've included a rough estimate in the ROI sheet).

I've attached our ROI snapshot and pulled the usage dashboard into one view for the call. I'll cover the caching and SLA tradeoffs; Marissa will present commit scenarios.

Available to join Thu 5/13 at 10:30 PT.

Best,

Lauren Bishop
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
(attachment: roi_snapshot_v2.xlsx - Excel)
(attachment: brightwell_q2_usage_dashboard.pdf - PDF)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@brightwelllabs.com>, Tom O'Neil <tom.oneil@brightwelllabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed commit scenarios for Brightwell (attached)

Alyssa / Tom — thanks for confirming the call. Per our prep, attaching a CSV with three modeled scenarios and quick bullets below.

(attachment: commit_scenarios_table.csv - CSV)

Scenario A — Conservative (12 months)
- Monthly committed tokens: 25M
- Expected unit price (avg): $0.0015/token
- SLA credit: standard (0.25% monthly uptime credit)
- Best for: flat growth, avoids overcommit

Scenario B — Growth (18 months)
- Monthly committed tokens: 33M (ramp 25M -> 40M over 6 months)
- Expected unit price (avg): $0.00125/token
- SLA credit: 0.5% monthly credit and 24/7 priority support for planned maintenance windows
- Includes: one-time onboarding credit toward dedicated pool if you elect to reserve capacity in Q3

Scenario C — Aggressive (18 months + dedicated)
- Monthly committed tokens: 45M (assumes July launch success)
- Expected unit price (avg): $0.0011/token
- SLA: 99.95% with dedicated capacity option; larger onboarding and migration support commitment

Notes:
- All scenarios include a quarterly usage review and one operational playbook session to optimize batching and cache config.
- DocuSign link included for scenario onboarding + standard addendum (https://www.docusign.com/xyz).
- We can model custom tranches if you want mixed-term splits (e.g., 12-month base + 6-month ramp).

Next steps:
1) Choose preferred scenario (or ask for custom tranche)
2) Procurement: we'll provide an ROI one-pager and final pricing sheet for legal/procurement
3) If dedicated capacity is chosen, we will scope sizing and timeline with infra (2–4 weeks to onboard)

Happy to run through the CSV quickly on the call.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Director | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@brightwelllabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Tom O'Neil <tom.oneil@brightwelllabs.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed commit scenarios for Brightwell (attached)

Thanks Marissa — this is exactly what we needed to move forward. Quick asks before procurement:
- Can you run a blended scenario: 12-month base at Scenario A with a 6-month add-on modeled to hit the July launch uplift (we want to avoid overcommitting if the launch underperforms)?
- Please include a one-page ROI that shows net platform savings under the Growth scenario vs. PAYG for procurement.

We’ll review on the call at 10:30; Tom will bring procurement questions. If everything looks reasonable we should be able to decide on a scenario and ask for a formal contract by end of next week.

Best,

Alyssa
